name: micromouse-26-teaser
description: UCD ElecSoc Micro-Mouse '26 launch teaser trailer

scripts.render:preview: remotion render Teaser output/master-preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --muted && node tools/finalise.mjs output/master-preview.mp4 output/micromouse-teaser-preview-v2.mp4
scripts.render:final: remotion render Teaser output/master-final-v2.mp4 --muted && node tools/finalise.mjs output/master-final-v2.mp4 output/micromouse-teaser-final-v2.mp4
scripts.build:all: npm run prepare-media && npm run audio && npm run render:preview && npm run render:final && npm run validate
scripts.dublin:render: remotion render DublinTeaser output/dublin-master.mp4 --muted && node tools/finalise-dublin.mjs output/dublin-master.mp4 output/dublin_micromouse_open_teaser.mp4
scripts.dublin:all: npm run dublin:prepare && npm run dublin:retime && npm run dublin:render && npm run dublin:validate
